Wow...even though it's the entrance to Eldenbaum,\nit's such a mess...
There seems to be many paths that are blocked.\nLet's first check out this place and see how bad\nit is before we continue.
Get back here once you're done.\nAll right, move your ass!

Report your findings...
The way in the direction of Fabriska Sector is\nblocked by thickly growing Eldenbaum's branches.\nIt's difficult to go from there...
Boo...the way in Altoale direction is blocked by\nbroken trees and building debris.
We need to clear everything to pass. I think the\nmonsters are to blame for this. Oh, it's giving me\na headache...
We also found only one way that seems to be fine\nfor us to pass straight ahead, right?
It was kinda eerie tho, cuz we couldn't see what\nwas ahead of us...
Umm, so the way in Morthell direction seems fine...\nIt may be dangerous, but it can't be helped since\nthere are no other ways...Let's go!
Wow! What the... Look!!
Looks like the huge branches that were blocking\nthe way were broken and fell down.\nYou can now proceed through the right side...
How could such huge branches be broken?\nCould it have been the monsters?
Possibly... I'm glad a new path cleared up without\nus having to waste our energy...
Captain, the wound of the elf warrior who got hurt\nin Morthell is more serious than I thought...
Go back to El Scaro. It's an order...
I-I'm fine!! It's all right!\nThis wound is nothing...
I know it'd be tougher to fight without you, but\neveryone including me wouldn't be able to bear\nthe pain of losing you forever...you understand?
Also, there's one thing I need you to do when you\nget to El Scaro. There's one more path in this\nforest that is blocked by debris...
For now, we'll try to go from the new path that\nopened up, but there's a possibility that we can't\nreach Dikkit Sector from there...
So, while we're trying our luck, I want you to\nrequest to King Elbano to send some sappers to\nclear the debris that is blocking the other way...
U-understood!! I will return to El Scaro now and\ntell King Elbano about your request, captain!!
I'm counting on you...
All right, guys...let's go find the new way to\nreach Dikkit Sector now!
The mountain of debris that used to be blocking\nthe way has been cleared...
Ooh?! Wow! It became accessible in an instant!!
Ya! Thanks to the injured warrior that went back\nto El Scaro and requested that it be cleared.
There were so many sappers here when I came back.\nAs you can see, we can now go from here. It's all\nthanks to them!
We need to thank them for clearing the debris so\nfast...Aight, let's make sure we find the way to\nDikkit Sector this time to repay their hard work!
I'm gonna make this place ready for the\nreinforcements coming later. You guys go ahead,\nI'll catch up to you. Be careful!
